name: Sassa Naruko
message: 「Well, the first semi-final match has concluded, and we are currently preparing for the second.」

name: Sassa Naruko
message: 「Sakura, what are your thoughts looking back at that first match？」

name: Nakamura Sakura
message: 「Man, honestly, before it started I was thinking Victoria was a sure bet to win it all again this year.」

name: Nakamura Sakura
message: 「But who would've thought she'd be eliminated in the semi-finals！ That's the Martial Festival for you—you never know how it’ll go until the lid is off.」

name: Sassa Naruko
message: 「What are your thoughts on Setsugekka, who managed to perform on par with—or perhaps even better than—a competitor like Victoria？」

name: Nakamura Sakura
message: 「Power and speed that rivals Victoria's, plus she's mainly focused on melee combat... she's just got way too many weapons in her arsenal.」

name: Nakamura Sakura
message: 「Whoever ends up winning the next match, I honestly don't think there's anyone left who can stop Setsugekka's momentum, you know？」

name: Sassa Naruko
message: 「So, are you saying that Setsugekka is effectively the guaranteed winner for this year's Toujinegi title?」

name: Nakamura Sakura
message: 「No, no, you never know！」

name: Nakamura Sakura
message: 「Depending on the kind of fight we see in this second match, the whole situation could easily flip on its head.」

name: Sassa Naruko
message: 「The second match is between two first-year Martial Arts Division students: Asahi Kuki versus Momiji Suzakuin.」

name: Nakamura Sakura
message: 「They both fought so well and were genuinely strong in their first matches！ I can't wait to see this one！」

name: Sassa Naruko
message: 「How do you predict the flow of this match will go, Sakura？」

name: Nakamura Sakura
message: 「What we learned in the first round is that Momiji's weapon is that pinpoint accuracy in her strikes—I don't know what else to call it but precision shooting.」

name: Nakamura Sakura
message: 「That level of skill? You'd be lucky to see it once every ten years, even among pros. It's on par with the legendary Jindou fighter, Sayuki Suzakuin.」

name: Sassa Naruko
message: 「I see, so she's the return of the former champion Sayuki！」

name: Sassa Naruko
message: 「Momiji is Sayuki's daughter—the eldest one at that—so it makes perfect sense.」

name: Nakamura Sakura
message: 「I'm not one to credit lineage, but you have to admit that kind of swordplay really does show they're mother and daughter.」

name: Sassa Naruko
message: 「Her opponent, Asahi Kuki, really put on a show in the first round as well.」

name: Nakamura Sakura
message: 「Since Asahi uses Iai, she's fundamentally going to want to fight from a waiting position. But her opponent is Momiji, a long-blade wielder.」

name: Nakamura Sakura
message: 「If Momiji keeps picking her apart from long range outside her reach, Asahi might find herself in a tough spot.」

name: Sassa Naruko
message: 「In that case, would you say Momiji has the edge here?」

name: Nakamura Sakura
message: 「Well, I’m sure Asahi is more than aware of that too. She’s absolutely come up with some kind of countermeasure.」

name: Nakamura Sakura
message: 「If she hadn't, there’s no way she could have made it this far with just her Iai draw！」

name: Sassa Naruko
message: 「Expectations for Asahi are certainly high!」

name: Nakamura Sakura
message: 「Like I said before, I’m rooting for Asahi. Once she graduates, I’d love for her to join our team！」

name: Sassa Naruko
message: 「Ooh, a personal love call from a pro player right there！？」

name: Sassa Naruko
message: 「Ahem... and we’ve just received word from tournament headquarters. It looks like preparations are complete.」

name: Sassa Naruko
message: 「Right then, everyone, thank you for waiting！」

name: Sassa Naruko
message: 「The second semi-final match: Kuki Asahi versus Suzakuin Momiji！ The match will begin shortly！」
I help Asahi put on her Spirit-Type Armament and perform a final check.

name: Iori
message: 「Alright, all systems green. The equipment is in perfect order.」

name: Asahi
message: 「Thank you very much.」

name: Iori
message: 「Is there anything else I can do for you？」

name: Asahi
message: 「In that case, a hug, please.」

name: Iori
message: 「...Hey now.」

name: Asahi
message: 「Hehe, it’s the eve of battle. Surely that’s acceptable?」

name: Iori
message: 「Good grief, you never change, even at a time like this, Asahi.」
I can't help but let out a wry smile.

name: Iori
message: 「But I’m glad you don’t seem nervous.」

name: Asahi
message: 「That’s not true at all.」

name: Asahi
message: 「Just imagining what it would feel like to dive into Iori-sensei’s chest makes my heart race.」

name: Iori
message: 「Yeah, yeah, sounds like a real struggle for you.」
I brush it off casually and wait for the entrance time.

name: Asahi
message: 「...Are you sure you don’t need to be with Momiji?」

name: Iori
message: 「Momiji turned me down, saying, ‘I’m fine on my own.’」
Momiji is currently by herself at the opposite entrance.

name: Asahi
message: 「Heh, that sounds just like her.」

name: Iori
message: 「Yeah, it does.」
She really is stubborn.

name: Ririmu
message: 「Hah, hah… I-I made it！」

name: Asahi
message: 「…Ririmu-san？」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Phew, the west and east entrances were further apart than I thought, so I ended up having to run a long way！」

name: Iori
message: 「The west side? Does that mean you were with Momiji until just now?」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Yeah, I went to go cheer her on and tell her to do her best！」

name: Iori
message: 「I see. Thanks.」
That’s a relief. So Momiji wasn’t alone after all.

name: Asahi
message: 「So, what did you come all the way over here for？」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Huh？ Don’t be so cold. I went out of my way to come cheer you on, you know.」

name: Asahi
message: 「Heh, thank you.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「So, how are you feeling？」

name: Asahi
message: 「I was finally alone with Iori-sensei, so I’m feeling a bit sensitive now that I’ve been interrupted.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Hey! Don’t treat your friend like a nuisance.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Actually, that sounds just like the usual Asahi. I’m glad you seem relaxed, though.」

name: Asahi
message: 「I’m sorry for making you worry.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「That look on your face—you don’t think you did anything wrong at all, do you? That part of you really pisses me off.」

name: Asahi
message: 「That goes both ways.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Yeah, I know.」

name: Asahi & Ririmu
message: 「Heh.」 「Ahahaha!」
They’re laughing happily. It seems the tension between the two of them has been resolved.

name: Umpire
message: 「From the East—Martial Arts Division first-year, Special A-Class, Takamura Class! Kuki… Asahiーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーー!!」

name: Asahi
message: 「Well then, I’m heading out.」

name: Iori
message: 「Yeah, go at them with everything you’ve got！」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Asahi！」

name: Asahi
message: 「Yes.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Don't you dare lose to someone like Momichi！」

name: Asahi
message: 「……Yeah, thank you, Ririmu.」
Saying that with a shy smile, Asahi passed through the entrance gate and headed toward the stage.

name: Momiji
message: 「Phew, well then. I suppose it’s almost my turn.」
Asahi’s entrance had begun.
Ririmu had been here just a moment ago, but she left saying she was going to go over to Asahi’s side.

name: Momiji
message: 「Well, I’m fine with being alone anyway, I find it calmer.」
Just as I was thinking that.

name: Miyako
message: 「……Ah, there you are.」

name: Tsubaki
message: 「Momiji-oneechan！」

name: Momiji
message: 「Huh? Miyako? Tsubaki? What are you two doing here！?」

name: Miyako
message: 「I told Father I really wanted to go see the Martial Festival, so he brought us.」

name: Tsubaki
message: 「When I told him that if Miyako-oneechan wouldn't take me, I'd go on my own, he gave us the OK!」

name: Momiji
message: 「Miyako, you really are something……」

name: Miyako
message: 「I didn't just leave without saying anything, I told him properly, so I think I'm doing better than before.」

name: Momiji
message: 「Miyako, you’ve really gotten good at handling Father, haven’t you~」

name: Miyako
message: 「Maybe I have you to thank for that, Momiji-oneechan.」

name: Momiji
message: 「Wait, no, I never taught you that, did I！？」

name: Tsubaki
message: 「More importantly, Momiji-oneechan, you have a match coming up, right?」

name: Momiji
message: 「Yeah, that’s right.」
I patted Tsubaki on the head.

name: Tsubaki
message: 「If you win, can you become a Toujinegi？」

name: Momiji
message: 「Hmm, it’s the semi-finals right now, so I suppose I could become one if I win two more matches~」

name: Tsubaki
message: 「Amazing…… you’re almost there！」

name: Tsubaki
message: 「When I grow up, I’m definitely going to become a Toujinegi！ So you better do your best too, Big Sister」

name: Momiji
message: 「Hehe, thank you」
There are things more important than becoming a Toujinegi.
I want Tsubaki to realize that too, but…….

name: Umpire
message: 「From the west—Martial Arts Division Year 1, Special-A Grade, belonging to ‘Takamura Class’! Suzakuin—Momijiーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーー!!」

name: Momiji
message: 「Alright, you two, I’m heading out」

name: Miyako
message: 「Good luck, Big Sister」

name: Tsubaki
message: 「Good luck, Big Sister Momiji~！」
Backed by their cheers, I headed toward the entrance gate.

name: Sassa Naruko
message: 「Now then~, it is time for the entry of competitor Momiji Suzakuin」
As I walked toward the stage, Asahi was waiting for me at the front.

name: Asahi
message: 「……I have been waiting for you, Momiji-san」

name: Asahi
message: 「Ever since I first met you, I thought that one day I would end up fighting you on this very stage」

name: Asahi
message: 「I believed that if I aimed to become a Toujinegi, you would inevitably stand in my way as a barrier」

name: Momiji
message: 「Hehe, I’m honored」

name: Asahi
message: 「That is why I have spent every day until now devising a strategy to defeat you, Momiji-san」

name: Momiji
message: 「Have you found a strategy？」

name: Asahi
message: 「Yes, thanks to you」
Geez, hearing something so depressing before the match even starts.

name: Asahi
message: 「Momiji-san, I would like to apologize in advance」

name: Momiji
message: 「For what？」

name: Asahi
message: 「From here on, I am going to deceive you」

name: Asahi
message: 「Sharing both the good and the bad within the team, encouraging one another while honing our skills together」

name: Asahi
message: 「I believe I am about to go against those very teachings of Iori-sensei」
It seems she has prepared some secret plan to take me down. Though I don’t know what it could be.

name: Momiji
message: 「...There's no need to apologize, Asahi-san.」

name: Momiji
message: 「After all, there are still mountains of things I haven't told you either.」

name: Momiji
message: 「Even between two people who've pledged their lives to one another, sharing absolutely everything is impossible.」

name: Asahi
message: 「Hehe, is that so? Then I suppose we're even.」

name: Momiji
message: 「Precisely.」
We share a laugh.

name: Sassa Naruko
message: 「Alright, preparations are complete. Time is up！」

name: Sassa Naruko
message: 「The second semifinal match—an all-first-year showdown nobody could have predicted—is finally about to begin！」

name: Umpire
message: 「Both combatants, take your stances！！」
I draw my Origami and activate my Tenju.

name: Umpire
message: 「Gather the myriad gods in divine assembly, deliberate in heavenly council. May heaven and earth be pure, may the six senses be pure; purify us, cleanse us...！」

name: Umpire
message: 「To the East, Kuki Asahi！」

name: Umpire
message: 「To the West, Suzakuin Momiji！」

name: Umpire
message: 「—Spirits high! Face one another, no false starts!」

name: Umpire
message: 「Now, fight fair and square—begin！！」
Asahi remains in her Iai quick-draw stance, staring straight at me. Just as the textbook dictates, she intends to open on the defensive.

name: Momiji
message: （So she's not going to pull out her trump card right off the bat, huh.）
Or maybe it's a counter-type secret technique, and she's waiting for my attack so she can spring it.

name: Momiji
message: （...Well, in that case, I suppose I'll play it by the book too.）
I know Asahi's reach inside and out from all the free-sparring bouts we've done together.
I slash in without any telegraph—only for Asahi's freshly drawn blade to deflect it.

name: Momiji
message: 「So fast—just what I'd expect from you, Asahi-san...！」

name: Momiji
message: 「Still... now that you've drawn that blade, I won't let you sheathe it again！」
Gradually picking up speed, I unleash a flurry of consecutive strikes.
Leveraging the reach of my long blade, I shower her with an unbroken barrage of slashes from the razor's edge of a distance she can't reach.
As Asahi tries to respond, my kote strike lands cleanly on her left wrist.

name: Momiji
message: 「There!」
The blade, extended mere inches from the ground, scrapes the Barrier Jacket on Asahi’s ankle.
Overwhelming her with sheer volume of attacks, I chip away at her wall of Tenju bit by bit, giving Asahi no time to counter.

name: Sassa Naruko
message: 「Whoa, this has turned into a one-sided match！」

name: Nakamura Sakura
message: 「Just as I read it. Momiji’s using the reach of that long blade to needle her from outside Asahi’s range.」

name: Sassa Naruko
message: 「Asahi is completely unable to make a move！」

name: Nakamura Sakura
message: 「Developments like this are tougher than the people on the sidelines realize. It hits your head before it hits your body.」

name: Sassa Naruko
message: 「She really needs to find a way to shift to the offensive, but…！」
The entire venue is leaning in, swept up in the torrential flurry of strikes I’m unleashing.
But she—and she alone—is different.

name: Momiji
message: （In this situation, you’d think she’d be feeling a little impatient at least！）
Humans have feelings. Anyone would think, 'Well, of course that's natural.'
But when pushed into a corner, humans have a way of letting those 'natural' things completely slip from their thoughts.
When they’re swayed by emotion and can no longer stay calm, people in that situation lose the ability to recognize it.
They always say a swordsman must remain calm at all times.
But even if you understand it in your head, putting it into practice is incredibly difficult.
It’s only when you’re actually facing a drawn blade, placed in a situation where that cold steel is coming to end your life, that you can truly grasp it.

name: Momiji
message: 「Don't you think it's about time you made a move…！？」

name: Asahi
message: 「Haha, I suppose so.」
Despite having her Barrier Jacket scraped by the previous attack, Asahi’s expression doesn't flicker in the slightest at my taunt.
Such composure while at a disadvantage. It’s as if I’m facing a veteran swordswoman.

name: Momiji
message: （Agh, she isn’t cracking at all… her defense is so solid！）
I am cornering Asahi, albeit slowly.
But at this rate, there’s no telling how long it will take to decide the winner.

name: Momiji
message: （…Wait, what am I doing getting impatient myself?）
Being pushed back this far and still not launching a counterattack is proof that Asahi lacks any effective means of resistance.

name: Momiji
message: （In that case, I’ll just overwhelm her with a flurry of strikes and finish this…！！）
Behind me are my three younger sisters. Miyako and Tsubaki are watching my match from close by.
I cannot afford to show mercy and risk losing the victory, not even by the slightest chance.

name: Momiji
message: （Don't take this the wrong way, Asahi――！！！）
A barrage of precise and unrelenting strikes bares its fangs at me.
I can't find an opening to counter. But I knew that from the very beginning.
Momiji wouldn't show an opening so easily, and I couldn't expect any mistakes from her precise strikes.
If that's the case, then what am I enduring for? What am I waiting for while trapped in this disadvantageous position?
Such self-questioning even crosses my mind.
A bit more of my Barrier Jacket was chipped away.
If things go on like this, I'll be defeated without being able to do a single thing, without even swinging my blade once.
It's impossible not to feel anxious in a situation like this.
I force down the urge to panic, and simply wait for that moment to arrive.

name: Asahi
message: （……Stay strong, Kuki Asahi）
A situation like this is truly nothing at all.
Remember, Asahi.
Compared to the bitter days my brother had to endure, this doesn't even qualify as hardship――
――I know.
I know the regret my brother felt when he returned home after his dream of becoming a professional player was crushed.
I know how he would cry out loud, alone in the shadows of the dojo at night.
I know that he still hasn't given up on that dream, and even now, he never misses a single day of training just as hard as a professional.
Even so, he always tries to act cheerful in front of me, never voicing a single complaint or grievance――
And now, I have finally arrived at the Martial Festival stage where my brother once stood.
I stare down Momiji, who continues to swing her blade at me.

name: Asahi
message: （……Momiji. I am not here solely to defeat you）
……I will absolutely become a professional Jindou player.
With this Iai, which I mastered by chasing after my brother’s back, I will become the Toujinegi.
I don't know if that's what my brother would want for me.
But――I cannot pretend that the cry of regret I heard from my brother that day never happened……！

name: Asahi
message: 「……Heh」
Strike as much as you like, chip away at me all you want. You cannot break my spirit.
The path to survival lies within a ten-thousandth of a second.
I will not miss it. At any cost, I will seize that split-second opening.
And then, at the very, very end.
I will prove that I was right――！！
A shiver runs down my spine.
Just as before, Asahi is doing nothing but defending against my barrage of attacks. It’s obvious to anyone that she’s on the losing end.
Yet, Asahi is smiling.

name: Momiji
message: （What is wrong with her...！）
No matter how hard I strike, Asahi doesn't budge. She is single-mindedly focusing on protecting herself.

name: Momiji
message: （...Hmm, this might not be good.）
While Asahi focuses solely on defense, I am the one launching the relentless assault.
As for who is burning through their stamina faster, it’s obviously me.
I am whittling down Asahi's Barrier Jacket little by little, but my own stamina is slowly being drained as well.

name: Momiji
message: （I can't even tell who's being worn down more at this rate...！）
...No choice, I'll have to initiate.
I've trained with Asahi countless times before. I "understand" almost everything about her.
Swordsmanship used, preliminary movements, spacing, tactical algorithms, offensive and defensive skills, frequent routines, combination patterns, and the probability of their combinations.
Gaze, expressions, blinking, breathing technique, muscle reflexes, habits, weight distribution, blind spot compensation, and every other physiological reaction.
Psychological tendencies, personality traits, interpersonal judgment, logical reasoning ability, thinking speed, stress tolerance, emotional regulation, and their strategic impact.
<center>It’s not enough, but for now, it will have to suffice.</center>

name: Momiji
message: 「――Shingan no Kiwamete, initiate！」
*Clack*, a switch in my brain flips on.
First move, predicted vanguard action... approximately 43 types.
2nd move 645, 3rd move 9,674, 4th move 145,381, 5th move 2,783,208, 6th move, 7th move, 8th move, 9th move, 10th move――
25 moves ahead, terminal node count approximately 2.6e+23, deriving the optimal solution from empirical evaluation functions.

name: Momiji
message: 「――Pathfinding, complete.」
Asahi’s defense is incredibly robust; I can't even see a future where I checkmate her 25 moves from now.

name: Momiji
message: （Yeah, yeah, I knew that from the start. It’s too early to use the Kiwamete...！）
It will take much more time to break through Asahi and defeat her.

name: Momiji
message: （But it’ll be a problem if she pulls out a trump card after I’m out of stamina. Actually, Asahi is definitely aiming for that, isn't she...！）
The reason Asahi remains at a disadvantage and refuses to break her defensive posture is that she has absolute confidence in that secret plan of hers.
There is no other reason for it.

name: Momiji
message: （Anyway, now that I've read her, I just have to do it...！！）

name: Momiji
message: 「...Here I come, Asahi-san.」
Taking on Asahi, I begin my trace—！
First move, low feint into an overhead wrapping strike—hit. Match rate 99.46 percent—target defensive speed, data corrected.
Second move, opponent's pivot―foot weight shift―speed ―4.51 m/s from prediction, reality match rate 97.893 percent―data corrected.
Third move, crushing her counter-initiative, kneecap-splitting thrust to the knee—hit.
Fourth move hit, fifth move hit, sixth move hit, seventh move hit, eighth move hit, ninth move hit—！
Hit, hit, evade, hit, hit, hit, hit hit hit—！！

name: Momiji
message: 「Land it... Secret Art: Swallow Reversal！！！」
The clinching blow landed.

name: Asahi
message: 「Guhhh...！！」
With the Barrier Jacket across her entire body shredded to pieces, Asahi wears an expression of agony.

name: Sassa Naruko
message: 「Whoaaa~~！ Momiji's fierce rush landed！ Is Asahi going to be okay~~~?！」

name: Nakamura Sakura
message: 「She did it in the first match too, pulling off impossible movements out of nowhere！ Even I couldn't dodge that！！」

name: Momiji
message: 「Hah... fwah...！」
Taking a deep breath, I immediately steady my ragged breathing.

name: Sassa Naruko
message: 「Sakura-san, almost every single hit in Momiji's combo just now connected with Asahi, didn't it？」

name: Nakamura Sakura
message: 「Yeah, she took 'em real clean.」

name: Nakamura Sakura
message: 「Still, every one of 'em was just a grazing slash from long range. She didn't get cleaved straight through.」

name: Nakamura Sakura
message: 「Considering the insane stamina and durability Asahi showed in her first match, there's no way she can't take this.」
...She's right.
In that combo just now, I prioritized keeping options where I could attack one-sidedly without ever stepping into Asahi's range.
As a result, it's true that the total damage dropped considerably.

name: Momiji
message: （Am I being too scared, maybe~...?）
No, that can't be it.
Against Asahi, who has won her way all the way here, I can't afford even a moment of carelessness.

name: Asahi
message: 「...It really is unreasonable, isn't it?」
Asahi lets out a long breath, staring straight at me.

name: Asahi
message: 「No matter how many times we've sparred, I can never dodge it. Every single read I make backfires.」

name: Asahi
message: 「The reason is obvious.」

name: Asahi
message: 「Once you get serious, you're capable of reading even my tactical lines almost perfectly.」

name: Asahi
message: 「Everything is in the palm of your hand. As long as this remains, I cannot defeat you.」

name: Asahi
message: 「How could I ever accept such an unreasonable fate……！！」

name: Momiji
message: （Nn……w-what……！？）
Just now, it was as if Asahi's body grew a size larger……！

name: Asahi
message: 「I have laid my hands on a taboo. I have done something that, under normal circumstances, must absolutely never be done.」

name: Momiji
message: 「A-Asahi…… could it be……」

name: Asahi
message: 「During my first training session, my body was so battered that I could barely walk.」

name: Asahi
message: 「My whole body ached so much that I thought it would be better to die than to continue training like this.」

name: Asahi
message: 「Even so, I never, ever gave up.」

name: Asahi
message: 「……Momiji, everything I do is to defeat you.」
……The sounds around me are fading away.
The shadow cast by Asahi is turning pitch-black, as if it had been filled in with ink.
No, that’s just what it feels like to me.
The unnaturally heightened hatred and killing intent that Asahi is directing at me.
That is what is making me see it that way.

name: Asahi
message: 「……Tremble, Momiji.」

name: Asahi
message: 「This is my, true seriousness.」
Without her even saying it, my skin was already crawling.

name: Momiji
message: （No way, you’re lying, there’s no way, no way……！！）
That stance, this unnaturally immense pressure――

name: Asahi
message: 「……Muragaki's essence, Tengen Saimei-ryuu——here I come.」
――――No, that's a lie.
What Asahi just showed was, without a doubt, the essence of Muragaki Iori.
Tengen Saimei-ryuu——it was the secret technique of the swordsman-killer.

name: Sassa Naruko
message: 「Oh my…… w-what just happened? Asahi-senshu's aura has suddenly shifted completely……！?」

name: Nakamura Sakura
message: 「T-this is…… could it be that thing……！」

name: Sassa Naruko
message: 「Sakura-san, do you know something about this？」

name: Nakamura Sakura
message: 「Yeah…… I'll never forget it; that was back when I was a third-year.」

name: Nakamura
message: 「The guy who made it to the main tournament of the Martial Festival as a first-year, just like Kuki Takahisa—I’ve forgotten his name, but he was freakishly strong when it came to the crunch...！」

name: Nakamura
message: 「He wasn't all that special normally, but when you cornered him, he’d start giving off an insane amount of killing intent.」

name: Nakamura
message: 「I nearly lost to him in the semifinals, and at that moment, I genuinely thought, ‘Oh, I’m dead.’」

name: Nakamura
message: 「That was the only time in my life, before or since, that I’ve actually been scared during a match, thinking I might really die...」

name: Sassa Naruko
message: 「So, are you saying that Asahi is using that same technique...？」

name: Nakamura
message: 「Yeah, when you see Kuki’s younger sister using the same thing that Kuki’s peer used, you can’t help but be suspicious...！」
As if responding to Asahi’s transformation, the atmosphere in the venue changed completely. It was shrouded in an eerie tension.

name: Momiji
message: 「Ugh, kuh...！！」
The moment I saw Asahi’s stance, my head started to ache.
My brain was screaming, overwhelmed by the sheer volume of fakes and feints being showered upon me.

name: Momiji
message: （Th-that’s impossible...！）
Tengen Saimei-ryuu is a secret technique of the Muragaki family, and naturally, it is never shared with outsiders. That is exactly why the Muragaki family has remained a threat to this day.
And yet, he just taught it to her, even if it was for the sake of a cute student.

name: Momiji
message: （But then again, Sensei is the head of the Muragaki family after all...！）
However, that’s not the core of the issue.
Actually, perhaps it wouldn't be a huge problem even if he taught Tengen Saimei-ryuu to someone.
Because usually, nobody could ever imitate something like that.

name: Momiji
message: （I mean, I’ve tried it myself！）
Ever since Iori-sensei showed me Tengen Saimei-ryuu, I’ve secretly tried to do the same thing many times.
But I could never imitate it.
That isn't something you can learn just because you're taught. It’s not something you can master in a month or so.

name: Momiji
message: （So why, how is Asahi able to do it...！ ）
The possibility of Asahi using Tengen Saimei-ryuu had existed in my mind.
But during the assessment stage, I immediately dismissed that possibility. Because it’s simply impossible to achieve.

name: Asahi
message: 「Fufu, are you wondering how I’m able to use it？ I’ll tell you, Momiji-san.」
Asahi stepped closer, one step at a time.
As Asahi closes the distance step by step, all I can do is retreat.

name: Asahi
message: 「I had a hunch about this from the very beginning.」

name: Asahi
message: 「For Iori, the Tengen Saimei-ryuu must be a burden. After all, he’s just too kind...」

name: Asahi
message: 「But I am different.」

name: Asahi
message: 「The Saimei-ryuu is a style meant to be wielded by someone as wicked as I am.」
...Ah, she might be right.
The Tengen Saimei-ryuu is a practice of wicked ogres and demons—to cheat and scheme, to deceive and sow chaos, to trap one's enemy in a web and devour them whole.

name: Momiji
message: 「It certainly suits someone like you who stops at nothing, Asahi...！」
Asahi takes another step forward toward us.

name: Asahi
message: 「That said, I didn't learn to use the Saimei-ryuu overnight.」

name: Asahi
message: 「I devoted so much time to making this technique my own.」

name: Asahi
message: 「Every single moment—while Momiji was eating, while she was sleeping, while she was talking—all that time, and more.」
With eyes burning like the fires of purgatory, Asahi showers me with a loathsome amount of malice and hatred.
The sight of her was even more chillingly perfect than Iori-sensei's.

name: Momiji
message: 「...That’s just madness.」
Has Asahi sacrificed everything just to master the Saimei-ryuu, all for the sake of defeating me?

name: Asahi
message: 「If the only way to win is to put in more effort than anyone else, then what other choice is there？」

name: Asahi
message: 「You are the hare, and I am the slow, heavy tortoise. And who was it that won the race in the end？」
Asahi’s smile, usually so composed, is now nothing more than that of a demon personifying evil.

name: Asahi
message: 「Come now, Momiji—let the race begin.」
I grit my teeth hard.

name: Momiji
message: （Don't mess with me, I won't let myself lose in a place like this！）
I whip my wavering spirit back into shape.
It's okay. Watch her closely.
Asahi is certainly using the Tengen Saimei-ryuu. But compared to Iori-sensei, she is still vastly inexperienced.
The moment I shifted my weight, a vast barrage of feints from Asahi rained down on me.
The thought flashes through my mind: in the next moment, the match will be over with Asahi’s Iai strike.

name: Momiji
message: （Saimei-ryuu combined with an Iai strike... that’s the absolute worst combination！）
From Asahi's perspective, this is all surely part of her calculation. Cold sweat breaks out across my entire body.

name: Sassa Naruko
message: 「Oh—and here, Momiji-senshu’s hands have stopped…！？ It looks like Momiji-senshu is struggling to find an opening」

name: Nakamura Sakura
message: 「Makes sense. She has to be careful here. One split second could be the end of her.」

name: Sassa Naruko
message: 「The crowd, too, has gone from the earlier excitement to holding their collective breath, watching to see how this match unfolds！」

name: Sassa Naruko
message: 「Just how long will this stalemate continue！」

name: Momiji
message: （That’s what I’d like to know…！）
Saimei-ryuu forces the opponent into a state of tension by bombarding them with a massive amount of feints, wearing them down before finishing them off with a single strike.
Act carelessly, and you’ll fall right into their trap.
That said, doing nothing won’t change the situation for the better.

name: Momiji
message: （If it comes to this, I have no choice but to try again…！！）

name: Momiji
message: 「――Shingan no Kiwamete, activate！！」
1st move, predicted opponent action… approximately 963 types.
2nd move, total nodes in the action tree: 53,920.

name: Momiji
message: （Ah, this is tough…！）
An massive influx of feints caused it to exceed the limit value at the 17th move.
Terminal nodes 2.1e+24. The optimal solution derived from this is――

name: Momiji
message: （…In the end, it’s Tsubame-gaeshi, huh.）
My secret technique, the 'Tsubame-gaeshi'.
A technique that focuses all Tenju into a single swing of the arm for a split second, unleashing two strikes in the blink of an eye with a high-speed recoil.
This makes it possible to perform two attacks in a single turn.
In other words, it allows me to skip the opponent's turn and unilaterally deal a second strike.
However, the mental exhaustion is severe, and it’s not something I can use often. You could say it’s also my final trump card.

name: Momiji
message: （But there’s no time to be hesitating now…！）
I steel my resolve and lock my blade's tip onto the center of Asahi's forehead.

name: Momiji
message: 「……Here I go！！」
1st move――opponent defense.
2nd move, opponent advances, reality consistency 35.017 percent――data correction impossible due to insufficient samples.
3rd move, torso-slashing from the right——evaded.
4th move evade, 5th move defense, 6th move defense, 7th move defense, 8th move evade, 9th move evade――！
Hit, evade, evade, evade, hit, evade, evade――！

name: Momiji
message: （Damn it, I can't land a hit...！！）
Because I don't have enough data on Asahi using Saimei-ryuu, my accuracy is too low and my predictions aren't working.
Still, once I've started something, there's no stopping now.

name: Momiji
message: 「I'll finish it with this... Secret Art: Tsubame Gaeshi！！！」
Asahi couldn't react at all to my first slash—nor the second on the return stroke—and her Barrier Jacket was shaved away.
—Or so I thought.

name: Asahi
message: 「...I've been waiting for this, Momiji-san！！！」
The blood drains from my face.
...No, it wasn't that Asahi couldn't react to my attack.
Aiming for the exact moment my Tsubame Gaeshi ended, she *deliberately* let me slash her—！！

name: Asahi
message: 「Geki: Raitei Issen！！！！！」
A tremendous shock tears through my body. I couldn't see her draw at all—truly a flash of instant annihilation.
Unable to even let out a scream, I was sent flying back.

name: Momiji
message: 「Gh, haah... haah...」
...For a brief moment, my breathing might have actually stopped.
My sense of balance is off. I force myself to stand.
Footsteps closing in toward me.
I somehow manage to parry the horizontal slash Asahi unleashes.

name: Momiji
message: （Jeez, she's got no mercy~...！）

name: Sassa Naruko
message: 「Oh~ she's up！ Competitor Momiji has somehow managed to get back on her feet！！」

name: Nakamura Sakura
message: 「That one was bad—she took it dead-on！」

name: Sassa Naruko
message: 「She somehow pulled herself together, but... is she going to be alright?」

name: Nakamura Sakura
message: 「A Barrier Jacket is basically like a stab-proof vest. It'll block the blade, sure, but it can't kill the impact.」

name: Nakamura Sakura
message: 「If she's unlucky, it wouldn't be weird if her ribs are busted...！」
I worried about that myself, but fortunately there's no fatal physical damage. I can still move.

name: Asahi
message: 「...That strike just now had a very solid feel to it.」

name: Asahi
message: 「I thought that would finish it, so you did well to endure it.」

name: Momiji
message: 「Heheh, I might not be on Victoria-san's level, but I'm actually pretty tough myself, y'know~」
No, that's a lie.
In that split second—a prediction of where Asahi's strike would land. Focusing my Barrier Jacket right there, I weathered that flash of instant annihilation.
If my prediction had been off, Asahi's strike would have pierced my thinned Barrier Jacket and sliced my body in two.
Thanks to that, I managed to stand up, but my Barrier Jacket is in tatters. I definitely won't survive the next one.

name: Asahi
message: 「……Well, that’s fine. Either way, the situation hasn't changed at all from before.」

name: Asahi
message: 「Tengen Saimei―ryuu, coming at you again―！」
I can't help but squint.
A storm of fakes and feints leaps into my field of vision. Filtering out the deceptive information is consuming all my processing power.

name: Momiji
message: （Oh for god's sake, how annoying……！！！）
The person who came up with a technique like this is quite something, but the person who went through the trial and error to make it a reality is absolutely insane.

name: Asahi
message: 「……I’m truly glad I ended up in the same class as you.」

name: Asahi
message: 「Thanks to that, I found out that Saimei-ryuu 'works' on you.」
……I see, so that's how it is.
That was back during the first sparring session with Iori―sensei―

name: Asahi
message: 「That is why I believe one should not seek out Saimei-ryuu so easily.」

name: Asahi
message: 「Though…… even if I stop you, I’m sure you’ll seek it out regardless, won't you.」

name: Momiji
message: 「Seeking out strong people to become stronger yourself. That’s just the natural order of things for a swordsman, isn't it?」

name: Asahi
message: 「I understand. I am a swordsman myself, after all.」

name: Asahi
message: 「That aside, I must admit, I have also wanted to see it.」

name: Asahi
message: 「What kind of reaction you would show when faced with Saimei-ryuu.」
――Asahi has been moving toward this moment since back then.
She had been planning for today, for this very day.

name: Momiji
message: 「Hahaha…… you really are a total monster, aren't you～……！」

name: Asahi
message: 「I know. That’s why I apologized at the beginning, didn't I？」

name: Asahi
message: 「That I would deceive you.」
I knew Asahi was the type of person to use her cunning.
But to think she’d go this far……！

name: Asahi
message: 「If you want to hold a grudge, you are free to do so.」

name: Asahi
message: 「Even so, I will defeat you and move forward……！！」
This tenacity, this resolve.

name: Momiji
message: （……Honestly, it's incredibly frustrating and infuriating to have to admit it, but still）

name: Momiji
message: （I envy you...！）
Stopping at nothing in order to survive. That is a true swordsman.
In the turbulent era when swordsmen shone brightest, it was surely someone like Asahi who would have survived to the very end.
And if I were that kind of person—I probably wouldn't have felt suffocated by being a Suzakuin.

name: Asahi
message: 「Now, suffer to your heart's content, Momiji-san...！」
Under the ever-intensifying hail of feints, my brain's processing power is forcibly dragged out and pointlessly overworked.
Assailed by a fierce headache, the sensation of my brain cells dying off.
This is bad...！

name: Momiji
message: （What do I do, Momiji, what should I do now...！？）
Yet my Barrier Jacket is no better than thin paper. There is no effective way to break through Saimei-ryuu.
I try to think of a way out, only for a sharp throb of pain to shoot through my head.
I'm at my limit—my brain was screaming.

name: Momiji
message: （Ah, this is... I might be checkmated...）
Just as I was about to fall into despair.
Suddenly, Iori-sensei's face floated into my mind.

name: Momiji
message: （...Oh, right）
I had forgotten until this very moment.
That's right, I have something Iori-sensei gave me, too.
Maybe I can do it now.
Closing my eyes, a deep breath.
And then slowly, quietly, I open my eyes.
Standing right in front of me, Asahi wore a puzzled expression.
I can see the announcer in the broadcast booth. Next to them, Nakamura Sakura.
Spectators sitting behind Asahi are looking at me and pumping their fists. Don't lose—that's what they were saying.
And filling my entire field of vision, people, people, people—.

name: Momiji
message: （So many people came to watch the match...）
The moment I abandoned thought, everything became crystal clear.
No, it wasn't that I was looking. Just accepting what was there, exactly as it was.

name: Momiji
message: （Ah, Asahi's hair sure is pretty~...）
Countless feints woven from Asahi's minute movements. Yet right now, they are nothing more than a part of the scenery existing in this world.
As I simply accept everything just as it is, a strange sensation washes over me.
An intuition, as if everything is melting away and becoming one.
Myself, Asahi, everything—I realize that all the things that had seemed bound by firm shackles were merely illusions created by thought.
My brain, which had been screaming until just moments ago, is now quiet.
Exhausted to the limit, having reached the breaking point, my brain finally accepted the shutdown.
And so, it realizes.

name: Momiji
message: （I see, the craving heart is what gives shape to things）
Just as thought gives birth to the yoke, things give birth to objects. Because there are objects, the 'self' is born and suffers.
Until a moment ago I was tormented by extreme tension, but now, I am calm.
If one simply accepts things as they are, without craving anything, then there is no way for suffering to arise.

name: Momiji
message: （…Iori-sensei, I think I’m beginning to understand, just a little）
This—what lies ahead—is the state of Shohou Muga—.
Suddenly, Momiji closed her eyes.
Closing one's eyes in the middle of a match is something that should never happen. It was a fatal opening.
If I launched an attack, I might be able to strike her down.
However, I sensed the strange aura she was emitting and stopped myself just in time.

name: Asahi
message: （…What is this sense of dissonance?）
Momiji had said as much: that there were mountains of things she hadn't taught me, even about herself.
Having secured an absolute advantage, there was no need for me to be impatient. After all, there was no way for her to break through Saimei-ryuu.
Or so it should have been.

name: Asahi
message: （Did Momiji's breathing change？）
As if taking a deep breath, big and long. And, a level of relaxation that I couldn't believe was happening during a match.

name: Asahi
message: （What are you doing, Momiji? Are you perhaps intending to give up on this match…?）
No, that was impossible.
I found it impossible to believe that the Momiji I knew would make such a decision.

name: Asahi
message: （If so, then what on earth…!）
I don't know what Momiji is thinking.
But something beyond prediction is about to happen. That much was certain—.

name: Sassa Naruko
message: 「…Both sides are staring each other down, and there's absolutely no movement. Will this ever reach a conclusion…！」

name: Nakamura Sakura
message: 「…No, there has been movement.」

name: Sassa Naruko
message: 「Eh？ But neither of them is doing anything…」

name: Nakamura Sakura
message: 「Momiji, she was being swallowed up by the strange killing intent Asahi was putting out until just a moment ago… but it seems she's broken out of it.」

name: Sassa Naruko
message: 「Eehhh！？ I can't tell at all… Sakura-san, could you provide some commentary？」

name: Nakamura Sakura
message: 「Don't say stupid things, there's no way I could provide commentary on this.」

name: Nakamura Sakura
message: 「This is a realm of masters that you can't possibly understand unless you've mastered the blade yourself！」

name: Sassa Naruko
message: 「U-Um, well, still... we did invite you here today to provide commentary, Sakura-san...」

name: Nakamura Sakura
message: 「Shut up, quit yapping and just watch. They're about to move.」

name: Sassa Naruko
message: 「Y-Yes, ma'am...」
Several minutes had already passed with Momiji and Asahi facing off in silence.

name: Ririmu
message: 「Ugh, this is getting so frustrating！」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Hey, Sensei！ Neither of them is moving！」

name: Iori
message: 「That's what a fight between swordsmen is really like.」
Between true master swordsmen, there are even times when they glare at each other without moving for over half a day.

name: Ririmu
message: 「Even so, doesn't what Asahi's doing right now look a whole lot like that whatever-ryuu style of yours, Sensei？」

name: Iori
message: 「Urk... I-I wouldn't know！」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Hmmmmmmmm？」
Since Saimei-ryuu was a secret between the two of us, I hadn't told Setsugekka, Ririmu, or of course Momiji about it.
I had hesitated to teach Asahi Tengen Saimei-ryuu.
Not just because it's the secret art of the Muragaki family. It's because it is undeniably a murderous sword style.
When I inherited Saimei-ryuu from my father, I wondered—in this peaceful age, why is there any need for a sword style meant for killing?
And then, when I was a student at the academy, I used Saimei-ryuu at this very Martial Festival and wounded Takahisa.
I genuinely thought such a detestable thing had no right to exist in this world, that it would be better off disappearing forever.
Yet once I became an adult, I understood.
Even if nuclear weapons vanished from the world, even if guns vanished, even if every weapon vanished.
Conflict between people will never disappear from this world.
Even if you lay down your weapons because you don't want to fight, you'll only be exploited and stripped of everything by those who resort to violence.
What matters is how you use the power in your hands.
The fault didn't lie with Saimei-ryuu, but with me for failing to control its power. When I was young, I couldn't admit that.

name: Iori
message: （...Maybe I wanted to settle that score.）
I had never had the slightest intention of teaching Tengen Saimei-ryuu to anyone, yet I felt that if it were Asahi, maybe it would be okay.
I'm sure I felt that way because she is Takahisa's younger sister.

name: Ririmu
message: 「Aaaah, I can't take this anymore! Sensei, I'm gonna go do something real quick!」

name: Iori
message: 「W-Where are you going？！」
Before I even had a chance to stop her, Ririmu dashed off toward the very front row of the spectator stands.

name: Ririmu
message: 「Aaaaaaaaaaasahiiiiiiiii！！！」

name: Ririmu
message: 「How long are you gonna just stand there staring off into space?！ You won't win if you don't go on the offensive！！」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Asahi, you're strong！ So have more confidence in yourself！！」

name: Ririmu
message: 「I know better than anyone that you're strong, since we've been training together all this time！」

name: Ririmu
message: 「So quit being chicken and go take her down！！」
Ririmu screamed at the top of her lungs.
Her cheering sent the temperature of the venue, which had been thick with an eerie tension, spiking all at once.

name: Spectator A
message: 「That's right! You can do it, Asahi!!」

name: Spectators
message: 「Asahi！ Asahi！」
Spurred on by Ririmu, chants of 'Asahi' erupted throughout the venue.

name: Sassa Naruko
message: 「Wow! The crowd is cheering so fiercely for competitor Asahi!」

name: Nakamura Sakura
message: 「Well, if this weren't a match, I'd say just shut up and watch, but...」

name: Nakamura Sakura
message: 「Still, this is the once-a-year Martial Festival！ It'd be a crime not to get hyped up！」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Asahi! Go, Asahi!!」
Ririmu, too, was joining the crowd in chanting Asahi's name.
Ririmu, who always used to say that people were responsible for their own affairs, was now cheering for Asahi—someone she supposedly hadn't gotten along with.

name: Iori
message: （"…You've changed, Ririmu"）
Though it was a shame she didn't make it to the main bracket this year.
But next year, she'll surely be even stronger.

name: Ririmu
message: 「Wha—！？ H-hey, what are you doing, suddenly petting my head—」

name: Iori
message: 「Ririmu, I'm expecting big things from you next year！」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Huh? Isn't it way too early to be talking about next year?！ The Martial Festival this year isn't even over yet, you know?」

name: Iori
message: 「Hahaha, you're right.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「More importantly, Teach, you should be cheering for Asahi too.」

name: Iori
message: 「No, I won't cheer for either of them. That would be playing favorites.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「You're as stiff as ever, Iorin！」
To Ririmu's wry smile, I shot back a brilliant grin.
A breeze was flowing through the arena.
The wind has no place where it begins, nor any place where it ends. It is merely a fluctuation of the atmosphere that connects everything upon the Earth.
I am Suzakuin Momiji. But that is nothing more than a single part in the midst of a great flow.

name: Momiji
message: （And right now, this match too... is just a fleeting instant in the flow of time, a mere moment...）
What I had discerned with my divine eyes up until now was no more than a tiny fragment of a much greater current.

name: Asahi
message: 「...What are you thinking about right now, Momiji-san?」

name: Momiji
message: 「I was feeling the wind.」

name: Asahi
message: 「...Wind？」
Overthinking only makes things complicated; if you simply accept things as they are, the world is simple.

name: Asahi
message: 「Could it be, Momiji-san, that you...！」
A slight tremor of agitation in Asahi

name: Asahi
message: 「Have you discovered it, the realm of Shohou Muga...！？」

name: Momiji
message: 「I'm not sure, though...」

name: Momiji
message: 「Somehow, it feels like everything has become very clear.」
Thinking about defeating Asahi is what traps you in Saimei-ryuu; if you merely accept, there is no reason to flinch.

name: Asahi
message: 「...Very well, then. Show me.」

name: Asahi
message: 「That realm you have mastered!!」
A godspeed Iai draw—Asahi's slash sweeping upward from below
Unleashed at a speed impossible to perceive visually, yet somehow I had blocked it.

name: Asahi
message: 「What about this...！？」
Asahi strikes again in a flash. Yet I block this one too.

name: Momiji
message: （...Why am I blocking Asahi's attacks？）
Before even that, how am I managing to block them? Even to me, it's a mystery.

name: Momiji
message: （I see, so this is the "wind"...！）
Whenever the situation shifts, a wind softly blows.
This "wind" is nothing more than a metaphor.
The accumulated information I hold and the flow of all things created by the world merge into one, appearing before my eyes as a ripple.
If fluctuations in the moving atmosphere are "wind," then what I'm seeing should probably be called a "wind of causality."

name: Momiji
message: （I get it now, Sensei... I finally understand what Iori-sensei meant...）
Cease all thought, and make yourself one with all creation.
Simply accept things as they are, feel them as they are, and unite your own actions with the flow of all phenomena.
That is the realm of Shohou Muga
The state of the world includes me as well, and the causality of the world appears before me as "wind" layered manifold.
All I have to do is trace the "wind" skillfully. Fortunately, I knew well how to do that.

name: Momiji
message: （This is just like Shingan no Kiwamete...！）
Without even realizing it, I had already taken a single step into the realm of Shohou Muga.

name: Momiji
message: （So if I do this, then maybe...！）
If I lightly swing my blade along the flow of the surging "wind"—
As an inevitable consequence, my blade struck Asahi.

name: Asahi
message: 「Saimei-ryuu isn't working?! That's impossible...!!」
There's no need to time my moves. The "wind" tells me when and how to move.
I deflected Asahi's blade as it flew at me faster than the speed of sound, and chipped away at her Barrier Jacket on the backswing.

name: Sassa Naruko
message: 「Whoa! Asahi is struggling to break through against Momiji! Sakura-san, the match has finally taken a turn!」

name: Nakamura Sakura
message: 「Look at Momiji... Looks like she's figured something out. Her movements are on a whole different level from a moment ago！」

name: Sassa Naruko
message: 「I-I'm afraid I can't quite tell, myself... In any case, Asahi is now on the offensive while Momiji holds her off！」

name: Sassa Naruko
message: 「Their positions have completely reversed from before！」
I batted away every single strike Asahi unleashed. It was an inevitability born of riding the "wind."

name: Asahi
message: 「...I see. So that's how it is.」

name: Asahi
message: 「Just like that, you effortlessly surpass everything I struggled so hard to obtain.」

name: Asahi
message: 「...Even though I was just one step away from finally reaching you.」

name: Asahi
message: 「Just to beat you—for that alone, I spent so much time enduring painful, endless training with no light at the end of the tunnel.」

name: Asahi
message: 「I held back from everything I wanted to do, everything fun—I sacrificed it all, and yet...！」

name: Asahi
message: 「You don't give any of that a second thought as you easily reach even greater heights.」

name: Asahi
message: 「I truly, truly... despise you...！！！」
The bloodlust radiating from Asahi swelled many times over.

name: Asahi
message: 「Someone blessed with natural talent like you could never understand this frustration...！！！」
The emotions Asahi was directing at me were ones I knew all too well.
Spite, envy, jealousy. Ever since I first picked up an Origami, those emotions have always been directed at me.
And in the end, everyone leaves my side.
For as long as I am a Suzakuin, for as long as I continue to wield an Origami, I will never be able to truly understand anyone.

name: Momiji
message: 「...I'm sorry, Asahi.」

name: Momiji
message: 「Even so, I must move forward.」
"Walking one's own path alone" is not a moral precept telling you to be that way.
It is a stark, earnest truth: without that resolve, you cannot even keep hold of yourself as a swordswoman.

name: Asahi
message: 「...Indeed. I am the same.」

name: Asahi
message: 「Even knowing the outcome, I cannot stop here...！！」
Asahi's eyes grow darker still, stained with abyssal shadow.
Her fierce fighting spirit and killing intent intertwine, transforming into a miasma.

name: Asahi
message: 「...Momiji-san. I am staking everything I have on this next strike.」

name: Asahi
message: 「Be sure to evade it. Otherwise—」

name: Asahi
message: 「You will die.」
There was not a shred of deception or exaggeration in those words.

name: Asahi
message: 「Hhh... Haaaaaaaaaaaahhhh———！！！」
Asahi drops into an Iai quick-draw stance, pouring everything into building up her Tenju.
Her abnormally heightened emotions, her obsession, every last ounce of what she possessed—she was pouring it all into that single flash of steel.
If I take that blow, with only my paper-thin Barrier Jacket, I'll be cleaved in two by a single stroke.
Overwhelmed by the fierce miasma radiating from Asahi—something akin to pure grudge—I lost sight of "the wind."
It was because I couldn't look directly at the bottomless hatred and madness Asahi was aiming at me.

name: Momiji
message: （...Calm down. I have to let go of my attachment.）
To look directly upon the causality of my own life being reaped by madness just as it is, attachment to life only gets in the way.

name: Momiji
message: （Can I really do something like that...？）
Could one truly cast aside the desire to live—something that is the very essence of life itself?

name: Momiji
message: （...It's not about whether I can. I have to do it.）
Didn't Asahi say so herself? That she's staking everything she has on this single strike.
Then I have to stake everything as well. That is the bare minimum courtesy I owe to Asahi, an unshakable swordswoman.

name: Momiji
message: （Take it all in, Momiji.）
Asahi's feelings, just as they are.

name: Sassa Naruko
message: 「Here we go—both fighters are still locked in a tense standoff！」

name: Nakamura Sakura
message: 「Hey, here it comes, here it comes...！ The next move decides it...！！」
I take a long, deep breath and focus my mind.
There is no longer any hesitation, nor any anxiety.
All things in creation, ever flowing and changing. If I simply entrust myself to that great current...
Look―I can see "the wind"―！！！

name: Asahi & Momiji
message: 「Obliteration: Raitei Issen！！！！！」「Secret Art: Swallow Reversal――――――！！！！！」

name: Umpire
message: 「……Match over！！！」

name: Umpire
message: 「East side, Kuki Asahi’s Barrier Jacket has been neutralized！」

name: Umpire
message: 「Therefore, West side, Suzakuin Momiji is the winner！」

name: Sassa Naruko
message: 「It’s decided-dddddddddddddd！！」

name: Sassa Naruko
message: 「The one who has conquered the second semifinal match is Suzakuin Momiji！」

name: Sassa Naruko
message: 「That final, breath-taking clash was absolutely incredible. How did it look to you, Nakamura Sakura?」

name: Nakamura Sakura
message: 「Ah, ah…… that final strike, I couldn’t even see who moved where for the life of me……！」

name: Sassa Naruko
message: 「Is the replay available……？ Ah, looks like it’s not.」

name: Sassa Naruko
message: 「It seems the final exchange from just a moment ago was so fast that even the high-speed camera couldn’t capture it.」

name: Nakamura Sakura
message: 「Obviously！ If a camera could catch it, there’s no way I would’ve missed it！！」

name: Sassa Naruko
message: 「Y-yes, you are absolutely right！」

name: Nakamura Sakura
message: 「Anyway, that was a hell of a show！ Truly worthy of the Martial Festival. That was an amazing, just an amazing match！」

name: Nakamura Sakura
message: 「Both of them were magnificent！ They should both be proud of that match！！」

name: Sassa Naruko
message: 「Ohhh, she’s got the seal of approval from Nakamura Sakura herself！」

name: Arena Announcement
message: 「Today's matches have concluded. Please take care not to leave any belongings behind as you exit.」

name: Arena Announcement
message: 「Repeating, today's matches have concluded. As you exit, please――」
